SELECT t1.* FROM (SELECT cac.credit_id, cac.allocation_id, cac.due_amount as write_off_due_amount, cac.principal as write_off_principal, cac.interest as write_off_interest,
cac.ARRIVE_MODALITY, (select scvb.MEANING from SYS_CODE_B scb , SYS_CODE_VALUE_B scvb where scb.CODE = 'CSH001_ARRIVE_MODALITY' and scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID and scvb.VALUE = cac.ARRIVE_MODALITY) as arrive_modality_desc,
t.contract_id, t.cashflow_id, (SELECT c.contract_number FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) contract_number, (SELECT c.legal_contract_number FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) legal_contract_number, (SELECT c.contract_name FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) contract_name, (SELECT p.contract_number FROM prj_project p, con_contract c WHERE p.project_id = c.project_id AND c.contract_id = t.contract_id) prj_con_number, t.times, t.due_date, t.due_amount, t.cf_item, t.cf_type, t.cf_status, t.cf_direction, t.calc_date, t.fine_days, t.write_off_flag, (SELECT scvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scb.code = 'FCT.WRITE_OFF_FLAG' AND scvb.value = t.WRITE_OFF_FLAG) AS write_off_flag_desc, (SELECT i.description FROM hls_cashflow_item i WHERE i.cf_item = t.cf_item AND i.cf_type = t.cf_type) cf_item_n, (t.due_amount - nvl(t.received_amount, 0)) AS surplus_amount, (t.principal - nvl(t.received_principal, 0)) AS surplus_principal, (t.interest - nvl(t.received_interest, 0)) AS surplus_interest, (SELECT c.tenant_id FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) bp_id, (SELECT bp.bp_name FROM con_contract c, hls_bp_master bp WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id AND c.tenant_id = bp.bp_id) bp_name, (SELECT q.quotation_id FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.source_document_category = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND t.contract_id = q.source_document_id) quotation_id, cwo.deal_date, cwo.last_update_date FROM con_contract_cashflow t left join csh_write_off cwo on cwo.cashflow_id = t.cashflow_id, con_contract c,csh_allocation_credit cac WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id and cac.cashflow_id= t.cashflow_id) t1 left join (select cashflow_id, max(last_update_date) as max_date from csh_write_off group by cashflow_id) c1 on t1.cashflow_id = c1.cashflow_id
1=1 and (c1.max_date = t1.last_update_date or c1.max_date is null)
and t1.allocation_id = #{allocationId}
order by t1.credit_id
